assumptions: All samples are synthetic and are not copied from any physical device or standard test.
Linear interpolation between adjacent samples is used for trapezoidal integration.
Leakage-current sign is positive into the device for charge integration.
Discharge current is positive out of the device and the supplied voltage/current pairs are simultaneous terminal measurements.
No converter, wiring, balancing or downstream load losses are represented.
The trace does not model voltage-hold aging, ESR evolution, electrochemical kinetics or statistical lifetime.
negative_controls: Do not infer delivered Wh from open-circuit voltage alone.
Do not treat leakage charge as delivered energy.
Reject traces with non-monotonic timestamps or incompatible units.
Reject missing simultaneous voltage/current samples for energy integration.
Do not extrapolate these two-segment traces to multi-day or multi-month lifetime.
Do not promote synthetic fixture arithmetic into physical evidence.
